nodes.name: Call Claude (Web Search)
nodes.notes: Uses Anthropic's server-side web_search tool — Claude runs its own multi-query research loop inside this one call and returns the final JSON in its last text block. No client-side tool loop needed. The Anthropic account must have web search enabled (Console → Settings).

nodes.name: Parse Candidates JSON
nodes.notes: Web search interleaves text/tool-result blocks — the model's final structured answer is the LAST text block, per the prospector system prompt's instruction to end with strict JSON.
